channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strikes near Ukrainian capital kill three, including child
item.description: Attack comes as US Senate passes new Russia sanctions and Kyiv appeals for air defence interceptors.

item.title: Saudi intelligence chief meets Iraqi PM, renews Riyadh visit invitation
item.description: Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi had cancelled an earlier Saudi trip after deadly July 29 US-Saudi strikes on Iraq.

item.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
item.description: Russia continued its overnight attacks after President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling supplies of missile interceptors.

item.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
item.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
item.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
item.description: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

item.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
item.description: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

item.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
item.description: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.

item.title: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
item.description: The student says she feared never seeing her mother again after the attack killed five teachers.
